vendors.pricing_starting: Not disclosed publicly since ~2020 (historical 2019 pricing was $800/mo for SMB tier)
vendors.pricing_notes: PartnerStack removed public pricing from its website around 2020 and now operates entirely on a 'contact sales / book a demo' model. Its own pricing page states 'Let us personalize a plan and pricing that suit your business.' Third-party benchmarking (Vendr) shows a median annual spend of $19,616/yr across 62 purchases, with a typical range of $9,186–$37,770/yr; Starter tier commonly runs $500-$1,500/mo, Growth tier $1,500-$4,000/mo, and Enterprise contracts $30,000-$100,000+/yr. PartnerStack also charges a percentage-based commission override fee (roughly 1.5%-15% depending on plan/volume) on partner payouts processed through the platform, on top of the base subscription. Sources: https://partnerstack.com/pricing, https://www.vendr.com/marketplace/partnerstack, https://affonso.io/blog/partnerstack-pricing-guide
